semantics.shape_rule: output shape exactly equals input shape
semantics.dtype_rule: canonical scalar codecs handle boolean, signed, unsigned, and floating inputs; complex inputs fail typed
semantics.numeric_rule: floating sign uses the encoded IEEE sign including negative zero and signed NaN; signed integers test less than zero; unsigned and bool are false
semantics.cancellation_points: before validation, at bounded element intervals, during upload, and before publication
semantics.vjp_rule: boolean sign classification is non-differentiable and its observed quantization call is forward only
semantics.jvp_rule: boolean sign classification has no tangent
